title: Build and Read: map
audience: Synthetic adult demonstration only; not a validated lesson

stages.title: Activate
stages.instruction: Say the word “map.” What sounds do you hear?
stages.coach_note: Invite a fictional learner to listen and say the sounds /m/ /ă/ /p/. This is modeled content, not a real assessment.
stages.response_prompt: Type the sounds you heard (fictional practice).

stages.title: Model
stages.instruction: Watch the example: m says /m/, a says /ă/, and p says /p/. Blend: /m/ /ă/ /p/ → map.
stages.coach_note: An adult models sound-to-letter correspondences and blending. The written pronunciation is illustrative, not a substitute for professional audio.

stages.title: Guide
stages.coach_note: Provide prompts as needed and mark help as assistance.

stages.title: Practice
stages.instruction: Try building the word from the letters m, a and p. Then read it.
stages.coach_note: Practice can involve hints. Do not label practice as independent mastery evidence.

stages.title: Apply Independently
stages.instruction: Without the model or audio, read this word: map.
stages.coach_note: The prototype records a self-reported response; it cannot verify spoken decoding or independently certify mastery.
stages.response_prompt: Type what the fictional learner read.

stages.title: Review
stages.instruction: Review how m, a and p combine to make map. Which step helped you most?
stages.coach_note: Reflect and plan another practice opportunity. Do not infer retention from this activity.
stages.response_prompt: Write one thing to review next time.
